loops.minute_1: Player clicks large cookie, earns 1-10 cookies per click. First upgrade (Cursor, +0.1 CPS) available immediately. Direct audio-visual feedback loop.
loops.minute_10: Passive buildings (Farms, Granaries) produce automatically. Golden Cookies spawn randomly (~15s lifetime), forcing periodic attention. Transition from active clicking to idle.
loops.hour_5: Ascension becomes viable (~tredecillion cookies). Complex strategies emerge: Grimoire minigame, Pantheon gods, Garden cultivation. Golden Cookie combos (Frenzy + Click Frenzy) require optimization. Wrinkler management introduces asset maturation.
loops.endgame: Repeated ascensions for Prestige gain (+1% CPS per level). 622 normal + 17 shadow achievements create endless objectives. Each cycle progresses asymptotically slower. Endgame is a prestige-multiplication loop with no terminal state.

objectives.player_goal: Maximize cookies baked and achievements unlocked through prestige cycles, optimization, and minigame mastery. No formal ending; completion is player-defined (full achievement list requires ~200 hours).

games.retention_answer: Player returns because: (1) immediate click feedback, (2) Golden Cookie urgency (15s timeout), (3) concrete achievement milestones, (4) continuous complexity escalation (minigames unlock progressively). Nested progression loops hide the endgame until each is reached.

loops.minute_1: Player places food and toys in yard, closes app. Gameplay is entirely off-screen. Cats only visit when app is closed (core constraint). No visible timer for food decay.
loops.minute_10_to_60: Player reopens app after variable delay (hidden timer). Discovers visiting cats, collects gold/silver fish rewards. Each cat has a soft-preference toy. Reward loop: food/toys → cat visits → currency gain.
loops.hour_5: ~30/66 cats collected. Rare cats (26 total) require specific setups. Player implicitly solves riddles: 'which toy attracts rare cat X?' Progression by gradual collection reveal.
loops.endgame: All 66 cats collected. Each cat has unique memento to unlock (~132 total targets). No end state; completion is a moving target. Progression is infinite with diminishing novelty density.
loops.minute_10: Player observes cats playing with their preferred toys and collects rewards. This is a key moment for understanding cat preferences.

objectives.player_goal: Collect all 66 cats and their 66 unique mementos through strategic toy/food placement. No penalty for failure; all progress is cumulative and irreversible.

games.retention_answer: Player returns because: (1) sessions are brief (2–5 min per visit), (2) collection curiosity (66 visible targets), (3) hidden causality (toy→cat mapping), (4) zero-penalty gameplay (no loss possible), (5) rewarding economy (each visit yields visible currency). Passive progression even while sleeping makes engagement feel effortless.

loops.minute_1: Player clicks monsters, earns gold, spends gold to level-up named heroes (Cid, Amangeaux, etc.). Heroes auto-attack (~0.5 DPS initially). Direct contextual feedback: dominating zones, not abstract accumulation.
loops.minute_10: Heroes auto-click dominates. Player discovers Ascension (~zone 130, ~10 Hero Souls earned). Hero Souls grant +10% DPS permanently. Ascension resets progress but multiplies power: psychological 'New Game+' feeling.
loops.hour_5: Mid-game ascensions repeated. Ancients purchased to refine strategy (crit damage, boss DPS, etc.). Build choices diverge: player discovers optimal Ancient combinations. Each cycle teaches a previously-naive strategy.
loops.endgame: Transcendence (second prestige layer) unlocks Ancient Souls (rarer, slower acquisition). Ultimate goal: maximize Ancient Souls/hour. Zones reach ~4725 with mathematically-infinite boss health. Optimization becomes fine-grained.

objectives.player_goal: Maximize Ancient Souls earned per hour through prestige cycles, strategic Ancient selection, and zone progression. No terminal goal; 'victory' is defined by efficiency optimization.

games.retention_answer: Player returns because: (1) prestige is accessible early (fast cycling = frequent rewards), (2) strategic depth (Ancient choice alters playstyle), (3) infinite zones (always a new boss), (4) efficiency metrics (Ancient Souls/hour = tangible optimization target). Continuous learning cycle: each reset corrects a previous naïveté.
